observations: Photo 0 shows the side profile of a black CRT television.

The screen is not visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The TV may not power on or may have a dead or flickering screen.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the TV powered on and displaying a test image.

risks.risk: The CRT may have significant image degradation or 'ghosting'.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the screen while it is on.

risks.risk: The TV may be missing the remote control.
risks.proof: A photo of the remote control.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the TV powered on showing the screen and any menu or logo.
Photo of the back of the TV showing the model number and power rating.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
